primer-linalg.html::node-305.source_text:
Fact — Formulas for the common induced norms
    
      $\|A\|_1=\max_j\sum_i|a_{ij}|$ (largest absolute column sum); $\|A\|_\infty=\max_i\sum_j|a_{ij}|$ (largest absolute row sum); $\|A\|_2=\sigma_{\max}(A)=\sqrt{\lambda_{\max}(A^\top A)}$, the spectral norm (Section 5); mixed: $\|A\|_{p\to\infty}=\max_i\|a_{i,:}\|_q$ with $\tfrac1p+\tfrac1q=1$ (e.g. $\|A\|_{2\to\infty}$ is the largest row length, $\|A\|_{1\to\infty}=\max_{ij}|a_{ij}|$) and $\|A\|_{1\to p}=\max_j\|a_{:,j}\|_p$.

primer-linalg.html::node-307.source_text: $\|A\|_1=\max_j\sum_i|a_{ij}|$ (largest absolute column sum); $\|A\|_\infty=\max_i\sum_j|a_{ij}|$ (largest absolute row sum); $\|A\|_2=\sigma_{\max}(A)=\sqrt{\lambda_{\max}(A^\top A)}$, the spectral norm (Section 5); mixed: $\|A\|_{p\to\infty}=\max_i\|a_{i,:}\|_q$ with $\tfrac1p+\tfrac1q=1$ (e.g. $\|A\|_{2\to\infty}$ is the largest row length, $\|A\|_{1\to\infty}=\max_{ij}|a_{ij}|$) and $\|A\|_{1\to p}=\max_j\|a_{:,j}\|_p$.

primer-linalg.html::node-311.source_text: Proofs. $|(Ax)_i|\le\sum_j|a_{ij}|\,\|x\|_\infty$, attained by $x_j=\mathrm{sign}(a_{i^\star j})$ for the worst row $i^\star$. $\|Ax\|_1\le\sum_j|x_j|\sum_i|a_{ij}|$, attained at $x=e_{j^\star}$. Each output coordinate $a_{i,:}x$ is bounded by $\|a_{i,:}\|_q\|x\|_p$ (Hölder, attainable). $\square$ Running example $A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 2\\ -1 & 1\end{bmatrix}$: $\|A\|_1=3$, $\|A\|_\infty=4$ (at $x=(1,1)$), $\|A\|_{1\to\infty}=2$, $\|A\|_{2\to\infty}=\sqrt8$, $\|A\|_2=2\sqrt2\approx2.83$: the longest semi-axis of the ellipse $A$ makes of the unit circle (Section 5, explorer).
